# Equipment, Weapons and Combat Gear Permits Guide
[italic]Permit approval is a privilege, not a right. No one is obligated to sign, and permits are void if not kept on your person.[/italic]
## Approval Process
- [bold]Order of Approval:[/bold] Seek stamps in the following order: Item Origin, [color=#fce742]Relevant Leader[/color], [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color], [color=#86d420]Central Command[/color]. - [bold]Relevant Leader:[/bold] The officially recognized highest-ranking person on station for a department or corporation listed on an item's approved list, such as the department head or interim department head. - [bold]Item Origin:[/bold] If an item physically originates from a specific department or corporation, approval must come from that department's [color=#fce742]Relevant Leader[/color]. Items without a origin (such as items found in maintenance) can be approved by any [color=#fce742]Relevant Leader[/color]. - [bold]NT-CC Items:[/bold] Any item approved for at least one NT-CC department must have a stamp from at least one of their [color=#fce742]Relevant Leaders[/color] (in addition to its origin, if applicable). Items not approved for any NT-CC department only need a [color=#fce742]Relevant Leader[/color] stamp from the Affiliated Corporation, barring weapons and enemy organizations which still need the below additional approval. - [bold]Enemy Organizations:[/bold] Since there are no officially recognized [color=#fce742]Relevant Leaders[/color] for enemy organizations, use the Enemy Organizations column in the table below to determine the [color=#fce742]Relevant Leader[/color] for said item. - [bold]Weapons & Combat Gear:[/bold] These items follow equipment permits but require additional Security approval per the table below. Further the [color=#ff6666]Warden[/color] may authorize [color=#ff4242]Security[/color] Combat Gear or Weapons where listed in the table without the [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color], acting as the [color=#fce742]Relevant Leader[/color].
